measurement.generated_files: all files in the generated tree except .jimu/manifest.json and docs/profiles/generated-report.md
measurement.direct_dependencies: non-indirect modules reported by go list -m
measurement.go_closure_files: non-test Go files in the package closure of ./cmd/server
measurement.go_closure_lines: non-test Go source lines in the package closure of ./cmd/server
measurement.non_code_assets: assets selected by the generated manifest outside cmd, internal, configs, and docs source files
measurement.readiness: 4 vCPU / 8 GB, local images; warm means Go build cache and local images are present, cold means the documented first-run path
